exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb te ageru".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞てあげる matches "Verb te ageru".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞てあげる.
exercises.explanation: Expresses doing a kind action for someone else using the verb te-form.
